carbon_policy_signal.item: EU Court upholds climate laws against Poland legal challenges; judicial credibility for ETS framework and coal retirement pathway reinforced.
carbon_policy_signal.why_it_matters: Judicial validation of EU climate framework removes legal overhang and supports EUA floor expectations; strengthens carbon-cost assumptions in thermal dispatch merit order and encourages retirement of coal-fired capacity.

freshness_caveat: Coal (as of 2025-12-26, 327 days old) and Clean Dark (as of 2025-12-31, 322 days old) are stale. Coal and thermal merit-order positioning unreliable; treat fuel-switch signals with caution. All other metrics current as of 2026-11-17 to 2026-11-18.
risk_flags: GB Power at 207 EUR/MWh (93rd pctile) — tail risk of demand destruction if sustained; monitor GB-DE spread blowout on interconnector constraints.
Clean Spark at −74.59 EUR/MWh (10th pctile) — coal has zero economic dispatch headroom; any renewable shortfall or cold snap could flip merit order violently.
Storage 70.15% (18 pp below 5-yr seasonal) — refill velocity into H2 2027 is critical with Russian LNG ban looming; supply tightness could rear in Q1 2027 if winter demand runs hot.
Coal data stale (as of 2025-12-26, 327 days old) — cannot confirm current merit order or fuel-switch dynamics; use with caution in position modeling.

base.summary: GB power elevated on island constraint; renewables volatile; coal out-of-merit persists. TTF range-bound; storage refill normal.

downside.summary: Sustained high renewables, mild weather, US LNG export surge via Atlantic arb suppresses TTF. GB demand destruction at 207 EUR/MWh. Coal stays stranded.

upside.summary: Cold snap drives heating demand, renewable shortfall forces coal back in merit. Russian LNG ban narrative accelerates. EUA rallies.

themes: GB power extreme premium; coal collapsed out of merit
Russian LNG ban 2027 tightens Atlantic arbitrage; US storage easing near-term pressure
EU climate policy credibility upheld; methane rule delay softens near-term enforcement
Storage 18 pp below seasonal; refill pace will shape H2 power risk
top_drivers: GB Power at 93rd percentile (207 EUR/MWh) — island supply constraint or demand spike; coupled with low renewables volatility (242% weekly swing), sets tone for forward curve risk.
Coal at 8th percentile and Clean Spark at 10th pctile — thermal generation economically compressed; any shortfall in renewables or cold snap will trigger violent merit-order flip and power spike.

Russian LNG ban effective 2027 — geopolitical supply shock forcing reroute to Asia; combined with US storage surplus (3,810 Bcf, +2% avg), creates competing LNG demand; near-term TTF support, long-term risk to H2 2027 refill.
top_takeaway: GB Power at 93rd percentile (207 EUR/MWh) dominates; Clean Spark at 10th percentile signals coal totally out-of-merit amid high renewables and low carbon. Russian LNG ban from 2027 threatens TTF structural support.

watchlist.why: GB premium widening to 93rd percentile signals interconnector stress or island isolation premium; spreads >100 EUR/MWh risk demand destruction or hedging flows.

watchlist.metric: TTF vs LNG Arb (Brent → LNG fob → TTF)
watchlist.why: Russian LNG ban 2027 and elevated US storage (3,810 Bcf, +2% 5-yr avg) are pulling transatlantic arbitrage tighter; watch for LNG swing towards Asia, tightening NW Europe supply.

watchlist.metric: EU Storage Refill Pace (% weekly change)
watchlist.why: Storage 18 pp below seasonal average (70.15% full); winter withdrawal rate and spring/summer refill speed will unlock H2 2027 TTF and power risk around Russian ban enforcement.
EU Court upheld climate laws and methane rule delayed; watch for EUA floor firming on policy credibility whilst delayed enforcement suppresses near-term upside.

watchlist.metric: Renewable Share Weekly Change (242.9% weekly pct move)
watchlist.why: Extreme weekly swing in renewables (-28.36% daily); if sustained at high levels, suppresses power prices further and extends coal out-of-merit regime.

watchlist_dated.name: COP31 final text — fossil, methane, electrification language
watchlist_dated.why: Outcome on EU electrification ambition and methane commitments will reset power demand and EUA curve expectations. Pragmatism signal already in flow; final text may soften or harden.
